dialog.title: Report an issue
dialog.description: Describe what went wrong. Everything that goes with your message is listed below, and nothing is sent until you send it.

picker.hint: Click the element you want to report

context.noElement: Page screenshot attached (no element pointed at).
context.elementAttached: Pointed element attached to the report.

attachments.label: Attachments
attachments.hint: Paste an image (Ctrl/Cmd+V), drag it onto this panel, or choose a file — images, PDF or text, 4 MB max each, 5 total.
attachments.dropHint: Drop the file to attach it to the report

errors.type: {{name}} — file type not accepted (images, PDF or text only).
errors.size: {{name}} is over the per-file size limit (4 MB).
errors.total: The total size of the attachments is over the allowed limit.

form.placeholder: What happened? What did you expect?

preview.title: What will be sent
preview.intro: Along with your message, and only when you send it:
preview.environment: Your browser and the app version

done.title: Thanks for the report!
done.subtitleWithReference: Report no. {{number}} saved with its context. Quote this number if you bring it up with the team.
done.subtitleStoredOnly: Your report is saved, but no number could be assigned to it — the team still sees it.

demo.message: The demo does not send reports: nothing you write here would reach the team. In your own workspace, this button sends the problem with its context, and you track it in Settings › My reports.

myReports.title: My reports
myReports.subtitle: What you reported, and where each one stands.
myReports.legend: “In progress”: someone is on it. “Closed without a fix”: closed with no correction.

states.emptyMessage: You have not reported anything yet.
states.emptyDetail: A report shows up here as soon as it is sent, with its status.
states.emptyDetailDemo: The demo does not send reports. In your own workspace, the ones you send show up here with their status.
states.error: Your reports could not be loaded.
states.partial_one: The status of {{count}} report could not be read right now.
states.partial_other: The status of {{count}} reports could not be read right now.
states.partialDetail: Try again in a minute: what you wrote stays here.

myReports.note: For useful feedback: the path you followed, what happened and what you expected.

help.title: Help & reports
help.subtitle: Describe the expected outcome, keep a trace of what blocks you.

report.title: Prepare a report
report.body: What you were doing, what happened, what you expected. Nothing is sent before you review it.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.body: The commands that make navigation easier.

data.title: Keep my work
data.body: Export your data before leaving the workspace.
